$comment: Per contracts/REPOSITORY-CONTRACT.md §Dependency-addition policy and contracts/CI-CONTRACT.md's dependency-allowlist gate. Every dependency declared in any package.json in this repo must have an entry here. scripts/check-dependency-allowlist.mjs enforces this at CI time. Adding a dependency without an entry here fails the build by design — this turns THIRD-PARTY-DISPOSITION.md's DO_NOT_ADOPT decisions into an enforced gate, not just documented policy (ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL-V3.md §11).

entries.name: astro
entries.purpose: Static site framework — the frozen architecture's chosen framework (ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL-V3.md §1).

entries.name: @ukbt/truth
entries.purpose: Internal workspace package (content schemas + truth gate) — not third-party.
entries.validation: N/A — internal workspace reference, not an external dependency

entries.name: @astrojs/check
entries.purpose: Astro's own TypeScript diagnostics CLI (`astro check`) — required for the typecheck gate.

entries.name: @astrojs/cloudflare
entries.purpose: Official first-party Cloudflare adapter — ACTIVE (emits dist/client/ + dist/server/entry.mjs; mirrored by wrangler.jsonc, enforced by check-deploy-mapping).
entries.validation: npm view @astrojs/cloudflare license (verified 2026-08-26); peer dependency compatibility with astro@^5 confirmed at install time (12.5.0 peers with astro ^5.0.0)

entries.name: @axe-core/playwright
entries.purpose: axe-core integration for Playwright — contracts/ACCESSIBILITY-CONTRACT.md's required automated a11y tool.
entries.validation: npm view @axe-core/playwright license (verified 2026-08-26); MPL-2.0 is a file-level weak-copyleft license with no bearing on UKBT's own source (dev/test-only dependency, not bundled into shipped output)

entries.name: @playwright/test
entries.purpose: E2E/visual-regression/accessibility test runner — contracts/VISUAL-REGRESSION-CONTRACT.md, contracts/CI-CONTRACT.md.

entries.name: @types/node
entries.purpose: Node.js type definitions — required for typecheck to resolve `process.env` in playwright.config.ts.

entries.name: typescript
entries.purpose: Language/typecheck tooling, shared root devDependency (also declared per-package for local tool resolution).

entries.name: @biomejs/biome
entries.purpose: Lint + format — contracts/REPOSITORY-CONTRACT.md, contracts/CI-CONTRACT.md's lint gate (A13).

entries.name: zod
entries.purpose: Runtime schema validation for content types (contracts/CONTENT-CONTRACT.md) and gate registry-id validation.

entries.name: zod
entries.purpose: Runtime schema validation for TinaCMS content loaders — validates JSON content at build time.

entries.name: vitest
entries.purpose: Unit test runner for the truth gate and content schemas — contracts/CI-CONTRACT.md's unit/integration gate.

entries.name: wrangler
entries.purpose: Cloudflare's official deploy CLI, invoked both by Cloudflare Workers Builds (`npx wrangler deploy`, Root directory `/`) and by the `workers-deploy` GitHub Actions job (`cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4`), both of which run from the repository root where `wrangler.jsonc` lives. Declared at root (2026-08-27, second amendment) after `pnpm exec wrangler` from root failed with ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL/ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT — a devDependency declared only in apps/web is invisible to `pnpm exec`/`pnpm add` run at the workspace root. Kept in apps/web too since nothing depends on removing it there.

entries.name: style-dictionary
entries.purpose: Token compiler — contracts/CSS-CONTRACT.md's chosen compiler (reversal from a bespoke script, ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL-V3.md §5).

entries.name: @sentry/astro
entries.purpose: Error tracking for the Astro site; activates only when SENTRY_DSN is set (astro.config.mjs), otherwise a no-op.

entries.name: @spotlightjs/astro
entries.purpose: Local dev error-overlay (Spotlight sidecar) for Astro debugging; dev-time aid only.

entries.name: @tinacms/astro
entries.purpose: TinaCMS Astro integration — provides tina() integration, TinaIsland component, data-tina-field attributes for visual editing.

entries.name: @tinacms/bridge
entries.purpose: TinaCMS bridge — enables visual editing communication between Tina admin and the site.

entries.name: tinacms
entries.purpose: TinaCMS core — content management, schema definitions, admin interface for client editing.

entries.name: @tinacms/cli
entries.purpose: TinaCMS CLI — provides tinacms binary for audit, build, dev, init commands.
